rubric.role_summary: Senior individual-contributor mechanical engineer designing and delivering complex subsystems from R&D through production and deployment for carbon-removal technology, with technical leadership and a focus on reliability and manufacturability.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior individual-contributor mechanical engineer designing and delivering complex subsystems from R&D through production and deployment for carbon-removal technology, with technical leadership and a focus on reliability and manufacturability.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience designing and delivering products through the full lifecycle, from concept to production.
- Experience with engineering analyses such as reliability modeling, tolerance analysis, FEA, fatigue analysis, and root cause analysis; the examples are not separate all-required gates.
- Experience producing drawings and specifications suitable for manufacturing and inspection.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Hands-on experience designing sheet metal, weldments, and plastic parts.
- Background in random vibration and fatigue testing, metallurgy, and material and test standards.
- Experience managing development in a product lifecycle management system (PLM).
- Experience operating in both fast-paced R&D environments and structured NPI execution.
- Experience using NX in a production or industrial context.
- Ability to apply engineering first principles, modeling, and data to real-world design decisions.
- Experience applying Design for Reliability principles, including failure mode identification, reliability modeling, accelerated life and stress testing, and using test results to improve designs.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technically complex projects or subsystems with minimal supervision.
- Track record of working cross-functionally to balance competing requirements and constraints.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
